learning_outcomes.text: Is capable of managing time, costs, specifications, human and material resources to achieve project objectives.
Knows the organizational structure and functions of a Technical Office.
Knows the procedure and regulations for processing and homologation of industrial equipment.
Is capable of autonomously and integrally preparing an industrial project taking into account current regulations, legislation, and rules.
Is capable of becoming aware of the multidisciplinary nature of industrial engineering, as well as its social, economic, and environmental implications.
Is capable of working in a team, applying critical reasoning, making decisions, and communicating knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Procedure and regulations for processing and homologation of industrial equipment.
Justification of preliminary studies, scope and types. Market Study. Technical Feasibility Study.
Economic feasibility study. Financial profitability indices.
teaching_methods: Classroom presentations of concepts related to the subjects and problem-solving
assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must obtain 5 points out of 10. There are no minimum marks for individual components. Students who do not achieve 5 points must take the entire subject in the extraordinary call, with no parts carried over. For students not passing through continuous assessment, the final exam will account for 70% of the grade, and the remaining 30% will be the average of the assignments completed.
